summary: 42-year-old male hiker lost his footing and fell down a steep embankment near Judd Falls north of Gothic, catching himself on a small ledge above the river; injured and unable to climb out, a ropes raise by CBSAR, Mt. Crested Butte police and EMTs lifted him to an ambulance for transport to Gunnison Valley Hospital.
